title: Pepsi Got Paid in 17 Soviet Submarines
description:
Pepsi got paid in submarines. Seventeen of them. Here's the sneaky reason why.

In 1989, the Soviet Union couldn't pay Pepsi in rubles, because rubles were worthless outside the USSR. So Pepsi took vodka... and then 17 submarines, a cruiser, a frigate and a destroyer. Pepsi never wanted a navy. It was just the middleman.

⚠️ Dramatised: characters and scenes are illustrations. The facts are real.
Myth check: no, this did NOT make Pepsi the "6th largest navy in the world."

Sources:
• History.com: How Pepsi Briefly Acquired a Navy
• Atlas Obscura: When Pepsi Had a Fleet
• The New York Times, May 1989 reporting on the deal
